messages:
Alex M: Quick async standup — model onboarding + evals. What I did: finished finetune job for customer-X on gpt-small-quant, ran baseline evals. Blockers: seeing a small quality drop on summarization prompts vs prod model (~3% BLEU-ish), need help triaging. Today: iterate on prompt templates, run targeted evals, ping for CR review on infra changes.

Priya K: Nice. Can you paste the eval summary? quick numbers are fine. Do we have diffs on examples?

Alex M: Sure, pasted below (high-level):
- Rouge-L: prod 0.62 -> new 0.58
- Exact match (QA): 0.81 -> 0.79
- Latency (p95): 180ms -> 160ms (good)
Selected failing example: "When summarizing long meeting notes, model drops action items."

Sophie Y: I can take a pass on prompt rewrites. If it's action-item recall, try a template that explicitly asks for bullets and labels: 
```
Summarize meeting notes. Return: 
- ACTION ITEMS:
- DECISIONS:
- NOTES:
Only include items with verbs.
```
I found that reduces truncation noise.

Marc L: Alex — pinging you on the infra CR (#842). I left one question about KV cache eviction defaults. I can review today if you address the comment.

Alex M: Thanks Marc, pushed a fix for eviction threshold to 0.6 and added a small test. PTAL. Also added a `--dry-run` flag to the onboarding script. PR link: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/pulls/842

EvalBot: Automated eval run 1769990123 completed. Summary: model=gpt-small-quant; eval_suite=onboarding-regressions-v2; baseline_commit=ab12f3; commit=cd34e5. Metrics: rougeL=-0.04, em=-0.02, p95_latency=-20ms. Top 5 failing prompts attached to run: https://artifacts.redwood/internal/evals/1769990123

Priya K: Hmm thanks EvalBot. Can we run a targeted eval that isolates prompt variants? I want A/B between current prompt and Sophie's template.

Sophie Y: I'll set up a quick prompt-sweep. Plan: 5 variants, 200 examples sampled from customer-X long meetings. Will post results as comments here. ETA ~3h.

Marc L: Also check that quantization knobs didn't change tokenization rounding on the tokenizer side. We had a similar drift last quarter. See: https://wiki.redwood/dev/quantization-notes

Alex M: Good call, Marc. I reran tokenization diff; no mismatch in vocab mapping but there are 3 sequences with unexpected split points. I'll attach examples to the eval run.

EvalBot: Tokenization diff for commit cd34e5 uploaded: https://artifacts.redwood/internal/token-diffs/cd34e5 (3 sequences flagged).

Priya K: Ok — Sophie, ping me when the prompt-sweep is done and I'll help analyze failure modes. Marc, if you can finish CR by EOD we'll roll a canary to Dedicated for a small subset of traffic.

Alex M: Thanks all — small todo summary: (1) Sophie runs sweep (2) Marc reviews CR (3) I attach failing examples and run targeted evals. Will post updates here. :thumbsup:
